must: Read colours from CSS variable tokens in app/globals.css
Danger is crimson-rose (190 18 80), never the brand red
One raised white page panel per page; navigation lives on the canvas
avoid: Decorative gradients outside the login brand cover
Internal jargon in UI copy (phase names, vendor names without explanation)

decisions.detail: Canvas-coloured sidebar, page in a raised rounded white panel, 14px base type, 12px card radius, KPI cards with icon tile + share chip, TECOMSA blue (29 78 216) accent with deep navy ink.
rejected: Command Deck (dark navy sidebar, hairline KPI grid)
Dense Ops Topbar (top nav, full-width tables)

decisions.decision: Adopt TECOMSA brand (company profile 2026) on the Inset Workspace layout
decisions.detail: Accent switched from blue to Tecomsa red; ink near-black; Poppins display font; pixel-mark Tecomsa lockup (hand-traced, replace with official SVG); login uses the red brochure cover. Supersedes the blue accent of the previous decision.
references: 21st: Number Ticker, Animated List, Animated Sidebar (patterns reimplemented in CSS)

decisions.detail: Hero card with animated ScoreRing gauges (Odoo/Frinzo fit, 70+ green, 40-69 amber), verdict line and research meta row; reasons as check rows with source chips; staggered evidence/signals.
references: 21st: Animated Radial Chart, Lighthouse Scores Radial Chart

decisions.detail: Company logos in Avatar via DuckDuckGo icon service (domain only) with initials fallback; branded floating empty-state art with pixel mark; sliding tab underline; table row fade-in; primary button hover lift; icons on all primary/save buttons; red welcome banner on dashboard.

PageHeader auto-selects a red gradient section icon tile from the URL (top-level pages), animated red rule under every header; Tecomsa logo loading splash; branded 404; ErrorState matches EmptyState floating art.

Motion tracks real data: numbers count up from 0 once per session per page (CountUp reveal), then animate on change; table rows flash when a refetch/poll changes them; new activity slides in at the top; skeletons dissolve into content (blur fade). No sparklines: the API has no time series, so trends would be invented.
references: 21st: Number Ticker, Number Ticker Real-Time Metrics Counter
